files.reason: Official DHS color specification: primary/secondary colors dhs-blue #005288, dhs-gray #c0c2c4, dhs-dark-gray #5a5b5d, dhs-red #c41230, dhs-light-blue #0078ae, dhs-green #5e9732, each with HTML/RGB/CMYK, a 90–10 tint scale, and Section 508 accessibility rules (min 4.5:1 contrast, color not sole conveyer). Directly usable to drive a code task's theme tokens and styling; observed as raw Markdown. Uncertainty: links on the page reference separate PDF/Excel palette exports not yet retrieved.

Component interface specification with real USWDS markup examples (usa-accordion, usa-button, usa-card, usa-collection, usa-grid, usa-icon-list, usa-list, usa-search, usa-site-alert, usa-summary-box, usa-table, usa-tag, usa-tooltip) and usage guidance. Provides the layout/component/interaction patterns a supporting-code task must implement. Observed and parsed as raw Markdown.

Form component specification documenting character count, checkbox/tile, combo box, date input/picker, file input variants, input prefix/suffix, process list, range slider, step indicator, text input states, time picker, and validation rules, all with markup conventions (usa-form, usa-form-group, aria-describedby, usa-input--error). Substantive behavioral spec for supporting form-related code. Observed as raw Markdown.

Typography reference: typefaces (Source Sans Pro, Merriweather), type-scale utility classes (font-sans-lg/xl/3xs, text-huge/tiny/base), list/link styles, and a 240-icon SVG library. Supports the design/interface specification for layout and type. Uncertainty: page mostly references USWDS utility class names rather than explicit numeric sizes/line-heights.

Real Jekyll page-shell layout showing the site skeleton: skip-nav, Liquid includes (head, site-header, site-footer, site-identifier), {{ content }} insertion, and USWDS JS bundle script tag. Concrete existing project code a new supporting-code task would extend. Observed exact raw content.

Substantial actual Liquid navigation component with a microsite-mode branch ({% if include.microsite != true %}), megamenu submenus, search form, and links to Components/Forms/Typography/Content/Microsite/Color Palette pages. Prime integration point for extending site navigation. Observed full raw content.

Real USWDS theme-token override file defining the DHS color scales ($c-dhs-blue-05..90, gray, dark-gray, red, light-blue, green), token mappings (primary, base, secondary, accent warm/cool), state colors, focus offset, and component overrides (button radius, identifier, card, sortable table, summary box). Directly supports implementing styling consistent with the palette spec. Observed and parsed.

Real custom SCSS defining non-USWDS components: .news-list (homepage news listing with metadata and category links), .meta-info.meta-info--block, and .meta-tags, using USWDS mixins and DHS color variables. Shows the project's custom-component conventions for extension. Observed and parsed; exact line-level content summarized because verbatim quoting is limited.

cases.identity: DHS Digital Design Guide — government style-guide website built with Jekyll/Liquid on the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS), with a published DHS color palette, component, typography, and form specifications and custom Sass/Liquid implementation
missing_information: Page-level content/markup pages (e.g., components.html, forms.html, typography.html outputs or their MD-to-HTML sources) are referenced by nav but only the .md specs were retrieved.
The _config.yml excludes/nav and the _site compiled output were not fully audited; build reproducibility (gulp/webpack pipelines) depends on package.json/gulpfile.js not selected here.
No explicit license file was observed at repository root; reuse/licensing is unconfirmed.
The color-palette page links to separate PDF/Excel palette exports that were not downloaded or verified.
Typography numeric scale values (px/rem, line-heights) are not stated explicitly in typography.md; they live in USWDS defaults.

rejected_candidates.reason: Real Jekyll design system, but README states patterns/templates are largely 'pictures' rather than code, no license file observed, and no native specification artifact (PDF/Excel) in a usable target format was identified; weaker i2/i3 pairing than the DHS repo.
Generic HTML template collection surfaced by search; provides no coherent project, design spec, or case-bearing implementation.
Single boilerplate template file with no design specification or project context; a blank/worked template rejected as a case anchor.
Marketing-grade generic template collection; no design specification document and no coherent real case.
Editorial listicle/aggregator returned by broad query; not a primary record or case-bearing artifact.
Truncated aggregator link to a beginner Figma guide PDF; generic tutorial/template, not a project case anchor.

stop_reason: A defensible, coherent real case was secured: the DHS Digital Design Guide repository is a complete Jekyll + USWDS government website whose published design specifications (color palette with exact hex/RGB/CMYK and accessibility rules, component markup, form and typography specs) and actual implementation code (page-shell layout, Liquid navigation with microsite branching, USWDS theme-token overrides, custom component Sass) were directly observed as raw native files. Eight files were selected within the materialization limit, covering both retrievable nodes (i2 source code, i3 design/interface specification). Remaining gaps are documented (license, PDF/Excel palette exports, compiled-page outputs, numeric type scale) and do not prevent an independent inspection and scoping of a supporting-code task.
